name: What are the local electrical codes for bathroom lighting in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What are the local electrical codes for bathroom lighting in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom lighting installations in Daly City, like other Bay Area cities, must adhere to the National Electrical Code (NEC) and local building amendments. Key considerations include using GFCI-protected circuits for outlets, ensuring proper fixture ratings for damp or wet locations (especially in showers), and maintaining minimum clearances from water sources. All electrical work should be performed by a licensed electrician to ensure compliance and safety. Permits are typically required for significant electrical modifications.
